mapper.select: select CSR.RSC_ID, CSR.RSC_NM, CSR.RSC_TP, CSR.RSC_PATN, CSR.RSC_DESC, CSRR.ROLE_AUTH, CSRR.REG_DT from JCMS_SCUR_RSC CSR left join ( select * from JCMS_SCUR_RSC_ROLE where 1=1 and ROLE_AUTH = #{roleAuth} ) CSRR on CSR.RSC_ID = CSRR.RSC_ID order by ${sort} ${sortOrd} limit #{start}, #{length}
select COUNT(*) from JCMS_SCUR_RSC_ROLE where 1=1 and RSC_ID = #{rscId} and ROLE_AUTH = #{roleAuth}
mapper.insert: insert into JCMS_SCUR_RSC_ROLE( RSC_ID, ROLE_AUTH, REG_ID, REG_DT ) values ( #{rscId}, #{roleAuth}, #{regId}, SYSDATE() )
